messages:
Iris (docs): opened PR #5237 to fix the migration guide and update the SDK snippet for streaming embeddings. small change but spotted a literal test KMS ARN in the example — will redact before merge.
Tom (platform): can you paste the preview link when it's up? want to verify TOC anchors.
Iris (docs): sure. snippet that needs redaction:
```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client(kms_key="arn:aws:kms:us-west-1:222233334444:key/aa11bb22cc33")
resp = client.stream_embed("hi")
```
Jin (sdk): yep redact. we usually recommend `arn:aws:kms:REGION:ACCOUNT:key/KEY_ID` placeholder.
Nina (security): open a sensitive-docs request and mark as example-credentials. I'll triage and try to quick-review today.
Iris (docs): filed RD-102 and linked the PR. adding a short advisory about not pasting live creds into docs/CI.
docs-build-bot: preview build queued for PR #5237 — https://ci.example.com/builds/5237
Tom (platform): build shows a link-check warning on the changed header slug. I can patch the redirect, but won't block this if the redaction flow is in flight.
Nina (security): can't skip link-checks. but redaction looks straightforward; once placeholder is in place I'm OK.
Leo (legal): quick read: draft advisory looks fine, suggest softer wording: "avoid pasting live credentials" instead of "do not".
Iris (docs): updated wording per Leo and replaced ARN with canonical placeholder. pushed and retriggered preview.
docs-build-bot: preview succeeded for PR #5237 — https://ci.example.com/builds/5237/preview
Nina (security): reviewed RD-102 and the placeholder. :thumbsup: passing to legal for final ok.
Leo (legal): approved wording in the PR comments. nothing else needed.
Iris (docs): planning to merge in the docs merge window at 10:00 PT tomorrow. will ping release notes and open a sweep ticket for other example files.
Tom (platform): sounds good. I'll follow up on the header redirect in a separate PR.
docs-build-bot: deploy queued for main (PR #5237) — will publish after merge.
